exposure: Ureterovaginal fistula after obstetric and gynecologic procedures
cohort: 25 patients who developed ureterovaginal fistula after obstetric and gynecologic procedures and underwent open ureteroneocystostomy.
finding: Early identification and repair of ureterovaginal fistulas results in a high success rate with complete cessation of urinary fistula, restoration of renal function, and complete restoration of urinary anatomy.
